# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-13 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_wizard_level13_widening.rs) to Wizard level 14 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-13 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation
# opposed), adding only the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th-level "Bonus feat" grants, and no level-15+
# progression. Three PF1 CRB primary sources (d20pfsrd, the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror, and legacy.aonprd.com) were read directly before
# writing this fixture, and all three agree byte-for-byte: base attack bonus
# GENUINELY RISES to +7 (`14/2 = 7`, up from +6 at level 13) and good Will
# GENUINELY RISES to +9 (`14/2+2 = 9`, up from +8), while poor Fortitude/
# Reflex both STAY at +4 (`14/3 = 4`, an integer-division coincidence with
# level 13). The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-14 row is
# "4/4/4/4/4/3/3/2" — up from the level-13 row "4/4/4/4/4/3/2/1" (the 6th-
# level column rises from 2 to 3 and the 7th-level column rises from 1 to 2),
# but the 8th-level column stays "—" (8th-level wizard spells do not become
# accessible until level 15), so the specialist bonus-slot flat count (one
# bonus slot of each spell level she can cast, 1st through 7th) STAYS at 7,
# unchanged from level 13 — a threshold stasis checked rather than assumed.
# Intense Spells' bonus-damage magnitude GENUINELY RISES to 7 (`max(14/2, 1)
# = 7`, up from 6 at level 13) via the pre-existing formula, not re-derived;
# Force Missile's uses-per-day pool stays level-independent and unchanged;
# Scribe Scroll stays recognized as an already-held grant. The level-14
# "Special" column is genuinely BLANK on all three primary sources (the
# Wizard's bonus feats land only at levels 5/10/15/20), so no new pillar is
# added at level 14 — only the already-grounded arithmetic pillars widen.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level14-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:14
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
